summary: First-round E2E testing of Lusorae MMORPG MVP. Backend pytest suite (17/17 PASS) covers auth (register/login/logout/me + unauth), game state/catalog, dispatch flow with busy-team validation, recruit + insufficient funds, buy vehicle, and launder validation. Frontend Playwright covers full happy path: register → HUD map with resource bar → click .opp-pin → OpportunityCard → select-team → dispatch-team-button → Teams panel recruit → Empire panel → logout. All critical flows work; polling & auto-tick spawning opportunities functional.

issues: Radix DialogContent warns 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' (accessibility warning, not blocking)

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add SheetDescription/aria-describedby to TeamsPanel and EmpirePanel to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py cookies use secure=True with samesite='lax' — works fine via HTTPS proxy; would break on plain-HTTP local dev but not an issue in the emergent preview.
engine.spawn_opportunities uses random.uniform for spot offsets; no seed/reproducibility concern for MVP.
routes_game.dispatch computes travel_s = dist / vehicle.speed which is meters/(m/s) = seconds — correct.
No pagination on /api/game/state events (limited to 30) and missions (100) — acceptable for MVP.
seed_admin correctly updates password when it changes — verified indirectly via successful admin login.
test_credentials: admin@lusorae.com / LusoraeAdmin2026! (works). New users registered dynamically per test.
seed_data_creation: seed_admin runs on backend startup; tests dynamically register throwaway users (email prefix TEST_/pw_/test_) — not cleaned up but non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at BASE_URL=REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, all endpoints prefixed /api. Auth uses httpOnly cookies (requests.Session works transparently). Opportunity/mission model requires waiting real time for full mission resolution (~2-3 min); current tests validate dispatch + team-busy transitions but not full outcome roll. Playwright: use '.opp-pin' selector to click leaflet div-icons. All key UI has data-testid.
